body:
## Overview
Major feature release adding full Nexo integration as a third custom item provider, Fortune enchantment support for enhanced drop rates, copper tool compatibility for Oraxen, and universal 256x256 texture support for all providers.

## 🎉 Key Features

### Nexo Support - Third Custom Item Provider
- **Complete Nexo Integration**: Full support for Nexo as an alternative to ItemsAdder or Oraxen
- **Paper Configuration**: Automatically generates Paper-compatible configuration files
- **One-Command Setup**: `/nexosetup` automatically configures all 128 custom items
- **Auto-Detection**: Plugin auto-detects which of the three providers is installed
- **Block Model Generation**: Generates proper Nexo block model configurations
- **Safety Checks**: Refuses to load if multiple providers or none are installed

### Fortune Enchantment Support 🎯
- **NEW**: Fortune enchantment now correctly increases letter block drop rates
- **Drop Rate Scaling**: Fortune I/II/III properly applies multipliers alongside Looting
- **Critical Fix**: Previously Fortune wasn't being detected - now fully functional
- **Enhanced Gameplay**: Players can combine Fortune + Looting for maximum drops

### Copper Tool Support 🔧
- **Minecraft 1.21.9+ Ready**: Added copper tools to Oraxen break whitelist
- **All Copper Types**: Copper pickaxes and axes now work with letter blocks
- **Modern Minecraft**: Supports new "Copper Age" update features

### Universal 256x256 Textures 🎨
- **Cross-Provider Compatibility**: All textures work with all three providers
- **Oraxen 1.203+ Compatible**: Meets Oraxen's texture resolution requirements
- **Dual Texture System**: 512x512 for ItemsAdder/Nexo, 256x256 for Oraxen
- **Python Conversion Script**: Automated texture downscaling tool included

## 📋 Installation

### Choose ONE Custom Item Provider:

#### Option 1: ItemsAdder (Recommended)
1. Purchase ItemsAdder from SpigotMC
2. Install CharmedChars-1.3.0.jar
3. Run `/iasetup` then `/iazip`
4. Restart server

#### Option 2: Oraxen (Free Alternative)
1. Download Oraxen from SpigotMC or GitHub
2. Install CharmedChars-1.3.0.jar
3. Run `/oraxensetup`
4. Run `/oraxen reload all`
5. Restart server

#### Option 3: Nexo (NEW)
1. Purchase Nexo from Polymart
2. Install CharmedChars-1.3.0.jar
3. Run `/nexosetup`
4. Run `/nexo reload`
5. Restart server

## 📄 Upgrade from v1.2.0

### For Existing Users (ItemsAdder/Oraxen)
- **Drop-in replacement** - no changes required
- Download CharmedChars-1.3.0.jar
- Replace old JAR in `plugins/` folder
- Restart server
- Fortune enchantment now works automatically
- Copper tools work if on 1.21.9+

### Switching to Nexo
1. Remove existing provider from `plugins/` folder
2. Install Nexo plugin
3. Install CharmedChars-1.3.0.jar
4. Start server and run `/nexosetup`
5. Run `/nexo reload`
6. Restart server

See [NEXO_SETUP.md](https://github.com/badbabywentaway/CharmedChars/blob/master/NEXO_SETUP.md) for detailed setup guide.

## 📝 Changes

### New Features ⭐
- **Nexo Integration**: Complete support for third custom item provider
- **Fortune Enchantment**: Drop rate bonuses now work correctly
- **Copper Tools**: Support for Minecraft 1.21.9+ copper tools (Oraxen)
- **Universal Textures**: 256x256 textures work across all providers
- **Enhanced Config**: Improved config generation on first run

### Bug Fixes 🐛
- **Fixed Fortune Detection**: Fortune enchantment now properly detected and applied
- **Fixed Oraxen Blocks**: Resolved invisible block issue after breaking
- **Fixed Config Generation**: Complete default config now generated correctly

### Documentation Updates 📚
- **NEXO_SETUP.md**: NEW - Complete Nexo setup guide
- **DEPLOY_AND_TEST.md**: NEW - Development workflow documentation
- **README.md**: Updated with Nexo and copper tool information
- **HANGAR_SHOWCASE.md**: Updated with three-provider support
- **VERSION.md**: Comprehensive v1.3.0 release notes

### Files Changed
- **283 files modified**: Major texture updates and new Nexo integration
- **3 new classes**: NexoProvider, NexoSetup, SetupNexoCommand
- **384 new texture files**: Complete 256x256 Oraxen texture set
- **Enhanced tests**: NexoSetupTest and updated integration tests

## 💯 Compatibility

- ✅ **100% Backward Compatible** with v1.2.0
- ✅ **No Breaking Changes**: All existing commands, features, and APIs unchanged
- ✅ **No Database Changes**: Structure database format unchanged
- ✅ **No Config Changes**: Existing config.yml files remain valid
- ✅ **Three Providers**: Choose ItemsAdder, Oraxen, OR Nexo

## 🛠️ Technical Details

### Requirements
- **Minecraft**: 1.21.10+
- **Server**: Paper or Paper-based (Purpur, Pufferfish, etc.)
- **Java**: 21+
- **Custom Item Provider** (choose ONE):
  - ItemsAdder 3.6.3-beta-14+ (premium)
  - Oraxen 1.181.0+ (premium with public source)
  - Nexo 0.1.0+ (premium)

### New Commands
| Command | Description | Permission |
|---------|-------------|------------|
| `/nexosetup [force]` | Auto-setup Nexo configuration | `charmedchars.admin` |

### Architecture
- **Three-Provider Support**: ItemsAdder, Oraxen, and Nexo fully integrated
- **Fortune + Looting**: Both enchantments work together
- **Universal Textures**: Single codebase supports all providers
- **Auto-Detection**: Runtime provider detection and validation

## 📚 Documentation

- **[ItemsAdder Setup](https://github.com/badbabywentaway/CharmedChars/blob/master/QUICK_SETUP.md)**
- **[Oraxen Setup](https://github.com/badbabywentaway/CharmedChars/blob/master/ORAXEN_SETUP.md)**
- **[Nexo Setup](https://github.com/badbabywentaway/CharmedChars/blob/master/NEXO_SETUP.md)** (NEW)
- **[Complete Changelog](https://github.com/badbabywentaway/CharmedChars/blob/master/VERSION.md)**
- **[How to Play](https://github.com/badbabywentaway/CharmedChars/blob/master/PLAY_INSTRUCTIONS.md)**
- **[Troubleshooting](https://github.com/badbabywentaway/CharmedChars/blob/master/TROUBLESHOOTING.md)**

## 🎯 Benefits

### For Server Owners
- **Three Provider Options**: Maximum flexibility in choosing custom item plugin
- **Fortune Enchantment**: Better drop rates for players using enchanted tools
- **Copper Tools**: Support for latest Minecraft features (1.21.9+)
- **Universal Textures**: Consistent experience across all providers
- **Same Experience**: All features work identically regardless of provider

### For Players
- **Better Drops**: Fortune enchantment now boosts letter block drops
- **More Tools**: Copper tools now work for breaking blocks (Oraxen, 1.21.9+)
- **Same Gameplay**: No difference in features between providers

### For Developers
- **Clean Architecture**: Three-provider abstraction maintains code quality
- **Easy Maintenance**: Provider-specific code isolated in dedicated classes
- **Comprehensive Tests**: Full integration test coverage
- **Well Documented**: Complete setup guides for all providers

## ⚠️ Important Notes

- **Install EXACTLY ONE provider**: Plugin refuses to load if multiple or none installed
- **Fortune Works**: Fortune enchantment now correctly boosts drop rates
- **Copper Tools**: Only work on Oraxen, only on Minecraft 1.21.9+
- **Resource Packs**: Switching providers requires resource pack regeneration
- **No Data Loss**: Structure database and configs preserved when upgrading

---

See [VERSION.md](https://github.com/badbabywentaway/CharmedChars/blob/master/VERSION.md) for complete technical details.
